intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes mt7925_roc_abort_sync to add early exit optimization when ROC is inactive while ensuring unconditional interface resume iteration for reliable cleanup
intent_record.what: Added early return guard checking MT76_STATE_ROC bit before proceeding with cleanup; changed cancel_work_sync to cancel_work; moved ieee80211_iterate_interfaces() outside the conditional block so it executes unconditionally
intent_record.how: Prevents unnecessary cleanup operations when ROC state is not active; changes synchronous work cancellation to asynchronous to potentially avoid blocking/deadlock; ensures interface resume iteration always occurs regardless of state bit value for complete cleanup

grouping_result.intent: Fixes mt7925_roc_abort_sync to add early exit optimization when ROC is inactive while ensuring unconditional interface resume iteration for reliable cleanup

vuln_statements.explanation: The mt7925_roc_iter function handles ROC (Rest of Channel) operation cleanup and interface iteration. Based on the vulnerability context indicating race condition or use-after-free vulnerabilities where timer/work cancellation may not properly synchronize with ongoing interface operations, this iterator function is the likely location of the vulnerability. The function iterates through virtual interfaces during ROC cleanup, and without proper synchronization mechanisms (such as proper work/timer cancellation before interface removal), it can lead to use-after-free conditions when accessing mvif or p structures that may have been freed.
